# All In One Calculator

> Free, fast, privacy-focused online unit converter with over 78 converter categories and 1,600+ units. Performs instant calculations in the browser with zero tracking and no sign-up required.

## Overview
All In One Calculator provides precise mathematical conversions for physical quantities, engineering units, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, electricity, magnetism, radiology, computer data storage, and number bases.

## Core Converter Categories

### Common Converters
- [Length Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/length): Convert meter, kilometer, centimeter, millimeter, micrometer, nanometer, mile, yard, foot, inch, light year, etc.
- [Weight & Mass Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/weight-and-mass): Convert kilogram, gram, milligram, metric ton, pound, ounce, carat, atomic mass unit, etc.
- [Temperature Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/temperature): Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, Rankine, Reaumur.
- [Volume Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/volume): Convert cubic meter, liter, milliliter, gallon (US), quart, pint, cup, tablespoon, teaspoon, cubic foot, cubic inch, etc.
- [Area Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/area): Convert square meter, square kilometer, hectare, acre, square foot, square inch, etc.
- [Time Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/time): Convert second, millisecond, minute, hour, day, week, month, year.
- [Speed Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/speed): Convert meter/second, kilometer/hour, mile/hour, knot, Mach, speed of light.
- [Data Storage Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/data-storage): Convert bit, byte, kilobyte, megabyte, gigabyte, terabyte, petabyte.

### Engineering & Scientific Converters
- [Pressure Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/pressure): Convert pascal, bar, psi, atmosphere, torr.
- [Power Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/power): Convert watt, kilowatt, megawatt, horsepower.
- [Energy & Work Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/energy): Convert joule, kilojoule, calorie, kilocalorie, watt-hour, BTU.
- [Force Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/force): Convert newton, kilonewton, dyne, pound-force, kilogram-force.
- [Number Base Converter](https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/number-base): Convert Binary (Base 2), Octal (Base 8), Decimal (Base 10), Hexadecimal (Base 16), and custom bases up to Base 36.

## URL Structure for Direct Conversions
AI assistants and agents can construct direct conversion links using the following URL structure:
`https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/[category-id]?from=[from-unit-name]&to=[to-unit-name]`

### Examples:
- Convert Meters to Feet: `https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/length?from=meter&to=foot`
- Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit: `https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/temperature?from=Celsius&to=Fahrenheit`
- Convert Kilograms to Pounds: `https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/weight-and-mass?from=kilogram&to=pound`
- Convert Binary to Hexadecimal: `https://www.allinonecalculator.com/convert/number-base?from=binary&to=hexadecimal`
